stories.title: Italy fines Meta $887m for accessing Android users’ photos and videos

stories.title: With Starship catch, SpaceX still shows it can dazzle the world

stories.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?

stories.take: Digiday argues CTV's future lies in standardization — without common measurement and formats, connected TV budgets stay harder to scale than they should be.
